title: EventBridge Scheduler with Lambda, Dual DLQ, and SNS Notifications
description: Scheduled Lambda execution with comprehensive failure handling using dual dead letter queues for both invocation and execution failures, KMS encryption, and SNS email notifications

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern demonstrates scheduled Lambda execution using EventBridge Scheduler with comprehensive failure handling through dual dead letter queue (DLQ) architecture.
EventBridge Scheduler invokes Lambda asynchronously every 5 minutes, with separate DLQs capturing both invocation failures (permission errors, throttling) and execution failures (Lambda exceptions).
Lambda execution failures are handled by Lambda's async retry mechanism (2 attempts) before being sent to the Lambda Execution DLQ.
EventBridge Scheduler invocation failures are handled by the scheduler's retry policy (3 attempts) before being sent to the EventBridge Scheduler DLQ.
Both DLQs are encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key and use Event Source Mapping to trigger dedicated processor Lambda functions.
Each DLQ processor decrypts messages and sends detailed failure notifications via SNS email, providing complete visibility into both types of failures.
The pattern implements least privilege IAM permissions with all resources scoped to specific ARNs (no wildcards).
During deployment, provide your email address for failure notifications
After deployment, confirm the SNS subscription email to receive notifications
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions including failure simulation.
